title: Chapter 233: Some False Names
content:
Chapter 233: Some False Names

"I must give her face."

"Okay, don't say too much. I haven't seen each other for a million years. I really want to see how much this girl has grown to now. She can compete with me as soon as she returns to the academy."

Several people looked at each other and then stopped talking.

The next moment.

The six people trembled and they instantly entered Zhuyun Peak.

On the top of the peak, inside a magnificent hall.

Xiao Yin had been waiting here for a long time, standing quietly in the hall watching everyone's arrival.

With just a glance, everyone recognized Xiao Yin.

"You haven't seen each other for millions of years, you've really not changed at all."

An old man felt a lot of emotion.

Especially Xiao Yin's eyes.

Although Xiao Yin didn't say a word, the calmness and confidence in Xiao Yin's eyes seemed to be like yesterday.

"My mentors, I haven't seen you for many years, so I'm fine."

Xiao Yin looked at everyone in front of him and said with a smile.

These six are all mentors from the inner court, including from the Literature Academy and from the Martial Arts Academy.

But this time they came to Zhuyun Peak together just to see Xiao Yin again.

Take a look at this peerless monster back then.

Some of them had a good relationship with Xiao Yin back then, while others had a bad relationship with Xiao Yin back then.

However, millions of years have passed.

The grudges of the past seem like jokes now.

"Xiao Yin, although I don't know the reason why I haven't returned for millions of years, I just want to say that the academy will always be your home."

“Welcome back.”

One of the long-haired old men looked at Xiao Yin and showed a loving smile.

He is not the tutor of the Martial Arts Academy, but from the Wen Academy.

However, there is no distinction between civil and military affairs in him. In his eyes, there are only students.

This is also the reason why he is loved by college students.

In the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, he was able to be promoted from the position of teacher and be competent for the position of tutor in the inner court.

Hearing the words of the old man with long hair, Xiao Yin nodded slightly.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Xiao Yin's eyes are rosy.

Seeing this, the other people felt complicated.

After a while, several old men left, and after a while, the remaining few old men also left.

In the end, only one old man was left.

The old man was named Tan Songci, the tutor of the Martial Arts Academy. When Xiao Yin first entered the inner courtyard, he entered his seat.

"teacher."

Xiao Yin personally served a cup of tea for Tan Songci, and then the two sat opposite each other.

"Girl, you've probably suffered a lot over the years."

Tan Songci glanced at Xiao Yin in a complicated way, and then took a sip of tea.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin shook his head and smiled, "I am now at the peak of the Immortal Emperor, so what's the point of suffering?"

Xiao Yin said it casually.

But as Xiao Yin's former teacher, Tan Songci still saw the sad look deep in Xiao Yin's eyes at a glance.

After being silent for a long time, Tan Songci continued, "I returned to the academy, what are the plans for the next step?"

"Planned?"

Xiao Yin was thinking about it and immediately said, "Make contributions to the family and attack the Immortal Emperor."

Above the Immortal Emperor!

Tan Songci was stunned, but then he thought about it and felt that there was no problem.

Until now, Tan Songci still feels incredible about the fact that Xiao Yin has become the peak of the Immortal Emperor.

Millions of years.

This is really incredible.

Could it be that Xiao Yin has been practicing for millions of years?

In fact, this was not difficult for Xiao Yin at that time.

It is almost abnormal that the Xiao clan has a strong fairy spirit in its ancestral land. In addition, almost all the strong people of the Xiao clan are in its ancestral land and guide Xiao Yin in turn.

In that case, it would be normal to become the peak of the Immortal Emperor with Xiao Yin's talent.

"Where is the list of Immortal Emperors?"

When Xiao Yin heard the three words "The Immortal Emperor List", he obviously had something strange.

Xiao Yin lowered his head slightly, not knowing what he was thinking.

I don’t know how long it took, Tan Songci left Zhuyun Peak.

Xiao Yin saw him off in person, standing at the bottom of the peak, looking at Tan Songci's departure back, Xiao Yin's expression was complicated.

At this moment, Xiao Yin suddenly looked aside.

I saw an old man in a civilian slowly walking towards him.

Dean of Tiandi Academy, An Lingyun.

"Zhuyun Peak, how do you feel?"

An Lingyun asked.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin had no expression on his face, "It's the same wherever he lives."

"Do I need to arrange some servitude for you?"

An Lingyun continued to ask.

Xiao Yin shook his head, "I prefer purity."

"By the way, what kind of force is that Huangcheng? It seems that there is no such force in the Immortal Realm."

Hearing this question, Xiao Yin raised his eyebrows slightly, "Have you investigated her identity?"

An Lingyun did not refute and nodded slightly.

Suddenly, Xiao Yin laughed.

"Director, that girl's identity is not simple. The power behind her, let alone the academy, even if my Xiao clan and your academy join forces, it may be just a joke in the eyes of the other party."

"If I were you, I would definitely try my best to make friends with her."

As soon as these words were spoken, An Lingyun's expression suddenly became solemn.

"Is it really that exaggerated?"

"What, do you want to give it a try?"

An Lingyun lowered his head and thought, and after a long time, An Lingyun left here.

Standing there, Xiao Yin sighed and then looked back.

"Can it be you?"

Somewhere in the inner courtyard, in an empty square.

Several young men and women can be vaguely seen observing the highest ranking list.

There are two lists, each with the highest point of the list of literature and martial arts.

At this time, Lu Xue and Xiao Luo also walked to the front of the list and looked up.

"Is this the list that Sister Yin mentioned?"

Lu Xue looked at the list in front of her and murmured to herself.

On the side, Xiao Luo nodded, "I heard that if you want to make a ranking, you still need to pay for it, and it is not expensive."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue immediately said, "Pay money? If there is a ranking on the list, there should be a very generous reward."

Otherwise, who would spend money to make the rankings without any trouble?

Pretend to show off?

As soon as this statement was spoken, someone on the side immediately said, "Yes, there will be many rewards for the first time on the list. After that, there will be rewards for every time you persist on the list."

The speaker is a young man carrying a long sword with a sharp look and his whole body exudes a faint sword intent.

Obviously, this person is a sword cultivator.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo immediately stepped forward and bowed and said, "Brother, I am here at Xiao Luo. I have just come to the inner courtyard. Please give me some advice."

Hearing this, the young man with swordsman also smiled slightly, "I'm down to Qin Feng and a disciple under the seat of the mentor Wang Hao."

Wang Hao is a mentor in the Martial Arts Academy.

Although Lu Xue, who was standing by, did not participate in the conversation, she still heard it.

Then Lu Xue looked at the list in front of her again.

After a while, Lu Xue suddenly said, "Qin Feng? Hey, it's still more than 70th place in the martial arts list."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was slightly stunned and quickly turned his head to look.

The next moment, Xiao Luo immediately took a deep breath.

"Brother Qin, you are really a dragon and a phoenix among people!"

Qin Feng also shook his head and smiled, "It's just a little fictional reputation."

But it can be seen from the naked eye that Qin Feng's smile became even worse.
